title_zh: 韦朝晖检查督导市第七次党代会筹备工作
title_en: Wei Zhaohui Inspects Preparations for Huaihua's 7th Municipal Party Congress
summary_zh: 9月18日上午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖检查督导市第七次党代会筹备工作，实地了解会议组织、服务保障等准备情况。
summary_en: On the morning of September 18, Huaihua Municipal Party Secretary Wei Zhaohui inspected preparations for the city's 7th Party Congress, reviewing conference organization and support arrangements.
